info.name: Language AI Service Language API
AIServiceLanguage
Batch detect dominant language over pre-deployed model.

items.docs:
The API returns the detected language and a related confidence score (between 0 and 1).  It supports passing a batch of records.

Limitations:
- A batch may have up to 100 records.
- A record may be up to 5000 characters long.
- The total of characters to process in a request can be up to 20,000 characters.

info.name: Batch detect health entities over pre-deployed model

items.docs:
The API extracts health entities in text records. For each entity, its type and confidence score (between 0 and 1) is returned.  It supports passing a batch of records.

Limitations:
- A batch may have up to 100 records.
- A record may be up to 5000 characters long.
- The total of characters to process in a request can be up to 20,000 characters.

info.name: Batch detect entities over pre-deployed model

items.docs:
The API extracts entities in text records. For each entity, its type/subtype and confidence score (between 0 and 1) is returned.  It supports passing a batch of records.

[List of supported entities.](/iaas/language/using/ner.htm#ner__sup-ner-entity)

Limitations:
- A batch may have up to 100 records.
- A record may be up to 5000 characters long.
- The total of characters to process in a request can be up to 20,000 characters.

info.name: Batch detect keyPhrase over pre-deployed model.

items.docs:
The API extracts key-phrases in text records. For each key-phrase, a score (between 0 and 1) is returned that highlights the importance of the key-phrase in the context of the text.  It supports passing a batch of records.

Limitations:
- A batch may have up to 100 records.
- A record may be up to 5000 characters long.
- The total of characters to process in a request can be up to 20,000 characters.

info.name: Batch detect pii and phi entities over pre-deployed model

items.docs:
The API extracts pii and phi entities in text records. For each entity, its type and confidence score (between 0 and 1) is returned.  It supports passing a batch of records.

Limitations:
- A batch may have up to 100 records.
- A record may be up to 5000 characters long.
- The total of characters to process in a request can be up to 20,000 characters.

info.name: Batch detect sentiments over pre-deployed model.

params.name: level
params.description:
Set this parameter for sentence and aspect level sentiment analysis.
Allowed values are:
   - ASPECT
   - SENTENCE

items.docs:
The API extracts aspect-based and sentence level sentiment in text records.
The text provided must have aspects for the model to detect otherwise the response is a blank array.

For aspect-based sentiment analysis, a set of aspects and their respective sentiment is returned for each record. Similarly, for sentence-level sentiment analysis, the sentiment is returned at the sentence level.

For sentiment analysis, confidence scores are provided for each of the classes (positive, negative, neutral

info.name: Batch detect text classification over pre-deployed model.

items.docs:
The API automatically classifies text into a set of pre-determined classes and sub-classes. A single class/subclass is returned for each record classified.

It supports passing a batch of records.

Learn more about text classification [here](/iaas/language/using/text-class.htm).

Limitations:
- A batch may have up to 100 records.
- A record may be up to 5000 characters long.
- The total of characters to process in a request can be up to 20,000 characters.

info.name: Batch translation for translate text to other language over pre-deployed model.

items.docs:
Translates a batch of text documents from source to target language.
A batch can contain:
  - up to 100 records.
  - documents length less than 5000 characters.
  - 20,000 characters in total as a sum of all documents length.

info.name: Gets a list of all Endpoints in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: endpointId
params.description: The OCID of the endpoint.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the project for which to list the objects.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: modelId
params.description: The ID of the trained model for which to list the endpoints.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: Filter results by the specified lifecycle state. Must be a valid state for the resource type.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
Specifies the field to sort by. Accepts only one field.
By default, when you sort by `timeCreated`, the results are shown
in descending order. When you sort by `displayName`, the results are
shown in ascending order. Sort order for the `displayName` field is case sensitive.
